items.title: Activity calorie adjustment
items.notes: Don't build yet (JC 12 Nov; replaces the optional 'Weight-trend calibration' idea). Needs R4 and R6. Per-person setting (default 100%) applied to the Google Health activity calorie credit. Body + General feedback AI compares predicted vs actual weight trend after 3–4 weeks and may suggest a new value with the reason; changes only if the user accepts. Manual change: AI acknowledges once, explains the effect, offers its recommended value + reason. Declined: record it, respect it, quietly allow for the known accuracy gap in later advice without repeating the offer; re-offer only when new evidence differs meaningfully (e.g. after another 4 weeks). Store suggestion/decision history (values + dates only).

items.title: Calorie target from measured burn
items.notes: Don't build yet (JC 12 Nov). Needs R4; R5 depends on it. BMR via Katch-McArdle (370 + 21.6 × lean mass kg) from a rolling average of the last 3–4 weigh-ins. Activity credit = Google Health total calories burned − BMR, credited in full and multiplied by the R5 adjustment. Shown with a label: 'N kcal burned · N deducted for your BMR (from body composition) · +N kcal from activity'. Target = BMR + activity credit − chosen deficit. No tracker data → BMR × 1.2, labelled as an estimate. Show alongside the current fixed targets first; switch per person only on JC's approval.
